identity.name: AutoBookd
identity.core_principle: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with SaaS utility.

headings.usage: All page titles, card headers, and major metrics.

rules: NO gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Primary color is for text/headings. Accent color is for CTAs/Links only.
Borders should be subtle (slate-200 in light, slate-800 in dark).

navbar.style: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-50

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg font-medium
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg

inputs.style: h-10 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns/modals
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl (0.75rem) for containers, rounded-lg (0.5rem) for inner elements

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. REFACTOR LAYOUT: Remove the Sidebar component entirely. Create a new 'Navbar' component and integrate it into 'Layout.jsx'.
2. UPDATE THEME: Modify 'index.css' and 'tailwind.config.js' to use the new color palette (Slate/Blue) and fonts (Manrope). Remove 'Space Grotesk' references.
3. REMOVE BRANDING: Search for 'Emergent' string in the codebase and replace with 'AutoBookd' or 'ARI Solutions'.
4. COMPONENT STYLE: Update Shadcn components (Button, Card, Input) to match the 'Swiss Utility' style (sharper radius, cleaner borders).
5. DATA-TESTID: Ensure all interactive elements (nav links, buttons, inputs) have 'data-testid' attributes.
6. NAVBAR LOGIC: The Navbar must be responsive. On mobile, use a Sheet/Drawer for the menu.
7. DASHBOARD GRID: Refactor the Dashboard page to use the 'Bento' grid layout defined in 'layout.grid_system'.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds.
Ensure high contrast for text (Slate 900 on Slate 50).
All components must be functional and interactive.
